'''Myke''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by<ref name="Written Word" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="RogueSquadron5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 5|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 5]]</ref> also known as the [[Myke]]. Its written language was rooted in the [[Sith (language)|Sith language]].<ref name="Written Word" /> By around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="EssAt">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that the [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]] would not be produced until around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. As such, its name would have had to be derived from the Myke [[Language/Legends|language]] by that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> the [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]] was named by a [[Unidentified Myke engineer|Myke engineer]] who felt the [[Starship|ship's]] twin-tailed design resembled a letter from their alphabet. The letter, despite being derived from its counterpart in [[Common Sith]], bore little resemblance to the Sith letter.<ref name="Written Word" />

==Behind the scenes==
Myke was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an article authored by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] through [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written Word" />
